codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the feature intent. During refresh, `fetchSheetData()` preserves the current filter state, `populateFilterOptions()` now restores visible select values from `appState.view.filters` after rebuilding options, and invalid stale selections are cleared deliberately when refreshed data no longer supports them. The added Playwright scenario exercises the reported regression by applying active non-search filters, refreshing, and verifying the visible control values, filter badge, summary total, and narrowed table rows remain aligned.
